mods.title: FNF: Lovers Angel Number (oneshot mod)
mods.description: PLAY THE SONG FROM FREEPLAY MENUA One-shot Mod featuring 2 angels who loves each other :DSince this mod has bit of intense camera movements.strumline background's also included so you can focus on chart!Characters Profiles:･Elmeena IasShe's a kind and polite high-tier angel who's around 500 years old, a.k.a. "The Angel of Compassion and Healing."She was the one who first saved Tear when she came to Heaven after her death. Elmeena is now Tear's senior and they're also lovers (lesbian).Can control the powers of light and healing, making her one of the powerful high-tier angel on Heaven. She's also intelligent as always ranking first in angelic academic exams. Despite all that, she has sworn to love the rather dumb Tear for the rest of her life.･Miracle TearA girl who passed away at the age of 15. Unable to handle her miserable life of poverty and the constantly getting bullied at school, she took her own life by hanging herself and became an angel.She is a lesbian. After being saved by Elmeena in Heaven, she fell in love with her and confessed her love and the two began dating.Countless wounds and bruises left by the bullying are deeply carved into her body like scars. Even after becoming an angel, or using Elmeena's healing powers, it couldn't be healed and remain on her body as if they were a curse. (They still hurt sometimes)Her name while she was alive was Tiara Kaneko (金子 星愛姫 / かねこ てぃあら).She always dreamed of becoming a princess with a beautiful crown.She's little daydreaming and not pretty smart, and she sometimes struggles to find the right words or express herself clearly. But despite all of that, she is a pure-hearted, caring, and kind girl. She has sworn in her heart to follow Elmeena for the rest of her life.hope u enjoy :3 by. Hijiki_Kumano

In the process, they end up stumbling onto a plethora of unique and expansive worlds contained inside of arcade machines. A series of strange and unexplainable events follows, leading both of them to reopen many old wounds as they struggle to cope with new ones.Now, what if I told you there was another version of this story? What if there was a much cooler, dangerous, handsome man that came before them?
